ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") made as of the address at 85 Van Woert Road, Spencer, NY 14883 and DANIEL GUTIERREZ and individual having an address at 4425 Greenwood Avenue North,Apt 408,Seattle,Washington 98103(Lot 15 Owner"), an individual, having an address at and 135 West 14" Street, LLC ("Developer"), a New York limited liability company, having an address at 29 West 30"h Street, 4" Floor, New York, NY 10001. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Lot 15 Owner is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improveiments thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of NewYork,known asLot15inBlock790on theTaxMapof theCityof NewYork,and by the street address 137 West 14" Street, New York, New York, and more particularly the “Lot 15 Land,” said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Lot 15 Building,” and the Lot 15 Land and the Lot 15 Building being herein collectively called the “Lot 15 Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain parcels of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York,known as Lot 16in Block 790 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and by the following street address 135 West 14"h Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the "Developer Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provision of this Agreement being herein called the “Developer Building,"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct an addition to Developer's Building (the "Addition")upon theDeveloper Land; WHEREAS, the Developer desires to construct the Addition with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted under the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork, effective December 15, 1961(the “Zoning Resolution") than would be permitted to be constructed on the Developer Land if the lot comprising the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, Developer desires to utilize the procedure available pursuant to Section 12- 10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the Lot 15 Land, and the Lot 15 Building, and the Lot 15 Premises, and the Developer Land into a combined zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") for the purpose of making available the excess floor area development rights for utilization in connection with the construction of theAddition;
